items.t: CVT shudder, surging or transmission failure
items.note: Outlander owners were quoted about $7,000-$11,000. Check powertrain warranty and bulletin coverage first.

items.t: Front crossmember rust lets control arm detach (recall)
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure on early models
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: Parts figure is for the transmission alone. A used unit can cost less.

items.t: Balance shaft belt failure
items.job: Replace timing belt and balance shaft belt
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $765-$1,141 for the timing belt job on 2003-2006 models. A water pump and tensioners add to the bill.

items.t: Rear suspension clunks and uneven tire wear
items.job: Replace rear lower control arm(s) and align
items.note: One rear lower arm on a later Outlander is quoted around $710-$1,180 at shops. Doing all three arms on a side costs more.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak and misfire
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $141-$273 for 2003-2010 models.

items.t: Temperature control knob hard to turn
items.job: Replace heater blend door kit per bulletin TSB-055-003 (instrument panel and heater case removed)
items.note: Priced from a comparable job: Mitsubishi bulletin TSB-055-003 requires pulling the dash and heater case, the same work as a heater core replacement, which RepairPal estimates at about $1,459-$2,118 total for a 2005 Outlander. Used as the basis because no separate blend door kit price or bulletin labor time was found. If only the knob itself is stiff, the fix can be far cheaper.

items.t: Exhaust leak at the front pipe gasket
items.job: Replace front exhaust pipe gasket with new bolts and springs
items.note: Gasket prices from the Mitsubishi parts catalog run about $18-$101 depending on engine. Labor is based on YourMechanic, which quotes about $198-$416 for exhaust gasket work on 2008-2010 4-cylinder Outlanders (about $673-$1,060 on the 2013 V6); rusted bolts can add time.

items.t: Plug-in hybrid power reduced warning
items.note: Diagnosis only: the repair depends on which part of the hybrid system set the fault, and should be under the hybrid warranty on most of these cars. RepairPal: about $122-$179 for diagnosis.

items.t: Hesitation, loss of power or stalling
items.job: Diagnose stalling and hesitation (read stored codes and data)
items.note: Diagnosis only: no common cause has been confirmed, so the repair depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists about $122-$179 for diagnosis on Mitsubishi models. Should be a warranty visit on these model years.

items.t: Adaptive cruise and collision warning drop out
items.job: Diagnose driver-assist faults and check front radar aim
items.note: Diagnosis only: a sensor recalibration or software update may follow and should be under warranty on these model years. RepairPal lists about $122-$179 for general diagnosis on Mitsubishi models.
